title: Kissed Smoky Chinese Chicken Tagine
description: A smoky, creamy hangover cure served in a ceramic tagine that blends Chinese spices with a whole30-friendly twist.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C and place ceramic tagine inside to warm.

Pat chicken breasts dry, season with smoked paprika, crushed chipotle, and a pinch of salt, then sear in hot coconut oil over medium-high heat for about 3 minutes per side until golden, and transfer to a plate.
Sauté diced onion in the same tagine until translucent, then add minced garlic and ginger, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in the remaining 1 tsp smoked paprika and crushed chipotle to coat the aromatics.
Pour in coconut milk and chicken broth, stirring to combine and deglaze the pan.
Add coconut aminos, lime zest, and lime juice, bringing the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Return the seared chicken breasts to the tagine, nestling them into the liquid, and cover tightly with foil or the lid.
Transfer the tagine to the preheated oven and bake for 25 minutes until the chicken is fully cooked and tender.
Remove from oven, stir in chopped cilantro, and let rest for 5 minutes with the lid on to keep the steam inside.
Serve the smoky, creamy chicken with a side of roasted vegetables or a simple green salad to keep it whole30-friendly.
